title: CSA Subscription Tracking Log
subtitle: Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: CSA Subscription Tracking Log covers subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication. The CSA program coordinator records Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. CSA Subscription Tracking Log keeps Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription exceptions visible until the CSA program coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use CSA Subscription Tracking Log at farm program, packing point, pickup site, delivery route, and subscriber handoff. Document subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication identity before Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription begins. Compare subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication findings with stated Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription criteria; route unresolved Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription issues to farm subscription operations reviewer.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription, identify responsible parties, farm program, packing point, pickup site, delivery route, and subscriber handoff, and the linked subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication source.

fields.label: Share type, season, frequency, and payment plan
Pickup site, route, authorization, and preference

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription facts for subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription tracked controls
items: Share contents and source lot where needed
Packing, hold, pickup, and authorized alternate
Missed pickup, substitution, credit, and donation rule
Season completion, balance, feedback, and renewal

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription event before closeout. CSA Program Coordinator identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription when subscription terms, payment, pickup authority, communication, or share disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription proof and route unresolved subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication scope to CSA program coordinator.
